name: Design System
description: Adds an admin-toolbar link that embeds an administrator-configured design-system (or any) URL in an iframe on a Drupal admin page.
project_description:
Allows your design system to be accessed from the admin toolbar.

 Features 
 
 Adds a menu item for your design system to the admin toolbar. 
 Displays your design system within Drupal's administration pages via an iframe, to avoid leaving the Drupal site to view your design system. 
 The URL to your design system is configurable. 
 Icon is added for core's admin toolbar 
 Supports gin's admin toolbar if installed 
 
 Configuration 
 After installing the module, configure the URL to your design system at `/admin/config/user-interface/settings` and adjust the permission to grant access to view the design system.
